units.source_text: 名人同我结下缘分，是从东京日日（每日）新闻社选我当告别赛观战记者开始的。

en.t: My connection with the Master began when the Tokyo Nichinichi, or Mainichi, newspaper chose me as the reporter to cover his farewell match.

units.source_text: 作为报社举办的围棋赛，那次场面之盛大空前绝后。

en.t: As a go match sponsored by a newspaper, it was an event of unprecedented scale, never equaled before or since.

units.source_text: 六月二十六日在芝公园的红叶馆开始对局，

en.t: The match began on June 26 at the Momijikan in Shiba Park,

units.source_text: 到十二月四日在伊东的暖香园下完这一盘棋，几乎花费了半年的时光。

en.t: and by the time the game was finished on December 4 at Dankoen in Ito, almost half a year had passed.

units.source_text: 断断续续地下了十四次。

en.t: It was played in fourteen sessions, with interruptions between them.

units.source_text: 我在报上连载了六十四回观战记。

en.t: I serialized sixty-four installments of match reports in the newspaper.

units.source_text: 不过，棋下到一半，名人便病倒了。

en.t: But halfway through the game, the Master fell ill.

units.source_text: 八月中旬到十一月中旬休战了三个月。

en.t: Play was suspended for three months, from mid-August to mid-November.

units.source_text: 由于名人病重，这盘棋更显得悲切了。

en.t: Because the Master's illness was grave, the game took on an even more sorrowful air.

units.source_text: 说不定还是这盘棋夺去了名人的性命呢。

en.t: It may even have been this game that took the Master's life.

units.source_text: 下完这盘棋，名人再也没能恢复健康，一年后就离开了人世。

en.t: After finishing the game, the Master never regained his health, and a year later he passed away.
